reviews.text: Kind, helpful and precise, thank you for everything and thanks to you too, Charly♥️
They should answer the phone... if someone has an emergency they can even die.

Despite having heard excellent reviews from friends, I'm forced to leave one star.
I'll start by saying that I'm not even sure whether my dog's examination was conducted by a doctor or just a nurse, given that it was the same person who answered calls and made appointments.
There was zero empathy for animals, with a strong prejudice, I don't know whether it was towards me (I'm Asian) or towards my dog ​​(a small-medium sized Staffordshire Bull Terrier).
First of all, a vet can't spend all their time asking if a dog needs a muzzle or if she's good, even though they saw her interacting with dogs in the waiting room and the dogs barking were other dogs. Moreover, after repeated reassurances from me with a demonstration of obedience, they finally gave up.
Second, despite having seen, after a manual examination, that the paw we came to check was OBVIOUSLY delayed in responding and differently from the other paws, and the dog was OBVIOUSLY stressed when handled in that area, they told me that that paw was fine without even ordering any further tests, despite having reported that the dog was running badly following an accident.
Finally, to confirm that there was prejudice against us, the attitude he had towards the patient and her owner changed completely after we approached us.
I'm truly disappointed given the kind words with which they introduced this clinic to me, and the great reviews I read here. However, it seems that type of service is reserved either for dogs considered "good," "cute, and cuddly" (mine is too) or only (this is my guess based on my experience, not an accusation) for more Western clients.
Too bad

I brought my dog ​​to this facility at my veterinarian's recommendation for an emergency hernia operation. They performed a physical examination and blood tests, but then told me that if he needed surgery—which was obvious and already indicated on the accompanying certificate—they wouldn't have time because they were already busy with scheduled surgeries. They then referred me to another facility and charged me €280.
I find this behavior extremely unfair. They could have told me right away, when I called explaining my needs, that they couldn't care for the dog and referred me elsewhere, thus avoiding wasting an entire morning with a dog in pain and visibly deteriorating.
Of course, that way they couldn't have earned €280 for 15 minutes of useless work.
Everything was perfect. The staff were friendly and the doctors were very professional and compassionate.

My experience with this clinic was unfortunately very negative, not because of the outcome of my dog's illness, which I obviously don't blame the doctors, but because of the lack of care, continuity, and attention throughout the entire process.

Zoe was having up to 3-4 seizures a day, despite the increased treatment. For me, it was a new and dramatic situation to manage, and I needed at least clear instructions and a medical referral. Instead, I called several times and was told, "The doctor isn't here, I'll have you call back," only to never be called back, while I was at home with a dog who continued to have multiple seizures.

The organization was also disappointing. On one occasion, I drove an hour with Zoe in her condition and took a day off because she needed three tests. When I arrived at the clinic, only one was performed. Later, the doctor realized that two were missing. When I objected to having to travel and take a vacation again due to the facility's oversight, the response was essentially that I could have done it elsewhere. No real accountability for the mistake.

Even more serious, considering the daily seizures, was what happened with Micropam, an emergency medication. Before the holiday closure, I had arranged for the necessary prescriptions so as not to run out. When I returned home, I found only one. I immediately called back: once again, "The doctor isn't here, he'll have you call again." No one called me back. With 3-4 seizures a day, a bottle can last very little, and in fact, we practically ran out of medication.

What was missing from the beginning was the sense of truly caring for the patient. And in the most difficult moment, when the MRI revealed a very serious situation with no surgical options, this feeling became even more evident: adding cortisone to the treatment and, effectively, that was it. Right on the eve of their holiday closure, without any real support in managing what would happen in the days to come, despite a dog with daily seizures and a situation destined to worsen.

In less than a month, I spent over a thousand euros on MRIs, visits, and tests. The amount isn't the problem: you do everything you can for your pet. But I would have expected the punctuality of diagnostic and financial services to be matched by equal attention to care. Instead, my perception was that the facility was much more present when tests and procedures needed to be performed than when answers, continuity, and support were needed in managing a seriously ill animal.

I wasn't expecting miracles. I was expecting attention, communication, and continuity of care. In a journey like this, feeling abandoned by the very specialist facility you've entrusted yourself to shouldn't happen.
Attentive to pet needs, booking in advance, prices similar to other specialist facilities.

I went to NVA today for a veterinary neurological exam. I arrived at the scheduled time and was immediately seen. The doctor who examined my pit was attentive and kind. She asked me lots of questions, listened carefully, and gave me instructions for any emergency related to my dog's condition. These are all things that are far from a given.

I will trust them for any future issues (neurological, of course).

A very positive experience, highly recommended!
Good, competent and very kind.

The checkup was performed by Dr. Martina, who did not operate on the cat.
Professional, humane, competent, and clear in her explanations.
Dr. Francesco, the cat's doctor, was also kind and professional.
Nothing to complain about, a positive experience. I wholeheartedly recommend it.
I had my first experience with Dr. Lombardo in 2002 with my Doberman for a brain tumor… Happy to have found him again and know that in case there is always

They handled our emergency as expected, with a very prompt examination and tests. The staff was very professional and friendly, which is something we shouldn't underestimate these days. Thank you from me and my Alpe.

Erika Tagliarini

I was living in the Canary Islands, Tenerife to be precise, when my 16-year-old daughter Elizabeth suddenly became very ill. They didn't know how to handle the situation, and knowing I was Italian, several people mentioned Professor Lombardo to me.
I immediately understood the seriousness of the situation and quickly returned to live in Italy. Elizabeth underwent brain tumor surgery and, despite her advanced age, was cared for by an extraordinary team: the anesthesiologist, the surgeon, Professor Lombardo, and all the staff.
From a human, psychological, and surgical standpoint, they were loving, incredibly sweet, and attentive to me and her at every moment.
A year later, my Elizabeth has been reborn. And that, for me, makes everything worth it.
With infinite gratitude to Professor Lombardo and his team ❤️

Excellent, very knowledgeable, and loving with my dachshund. I will never thank Dr. Iocca enough. He operated on my Leo twice (in 2023 and yesterday) for various dorsal and cervical hernias, with all the associated risks due to his age, which is almost 16 years old, and his medical conditions. Everything went very well. I also thank Dr. Bonaldi for her valuable neurological support and constant presence. Well done everyone, excellent pre- and post-operative support.
Excellent experience. A truly lovely visit with the dog. Simple but thorough explanations.
I came here with my mother for a problem with her Maltese. The staff was kind, friendly, and knowledgeable. I definitely recommend booking.

ABSOLUTELY NEGATIVE EXPERIENCE. The neurologist apparently doesn't even like dogs. Total coldness. The anesthesiologist feigned kindness; in reality, I realized she was mocking me for my concern for my dog. After undergoing an MRI, she came home terrified; not only that, but she limps and complains when I remove her coat. Obviously, before their surgery, she was fine. The MRI was normal, and the cerebrospinal fluid removed revealed no problems. So, either they handled her roughly or they damaged her while removing the cervical fluid. I don't recommend this place. They don't like animals and can't stand people like me who love and respect them.
Good
Excellent veterinarians, excellent organization. Professional.

When the situation is serious, you want nothing but the best.
The best are here.
Professionalism. Expertise. Empathy.

Thank you for everything you've done for us. We will never forget it.
Competent and friendly staff
Professional and very kind

Luckily, I found this clinic by chance. I live in Germany, where an operation like the one they did costs three times what I paid there, and the treatment is a complete scam.
After several phone calls for help and medical consultations with these very kind people, in the space of a week, leaving Germany on Sunday evening and returning on Tuesday evening, they put my four-legged friend back on his feet.
A herniated disc at C6-C7 was operated on almost immediately, just the time for the routine checks and off we go... I owe them my peace of mind. The operation was performed on Monday, and we're already home. THANK YOU so much.

I only learned about this clinic a month ago, when my fox terrier was struck by rapidly progressing paralysis. My visit with Dr. Baccolini, a humane and professional person, was heartened. I can say the same for the entire staff, who were kind and empathetic.

I had my first experience at this clinic in 2012, and returned today in 2025 with another dog, and my opinion hasn't changed. The professionals are extremely professional, especially Dr. Cozzi, who examined my dogs with the utmost care, attention, professionalism, and expertise, as well as being available to answer any questions or concerns. She also had a wonderful approach to the dog, with so much patience and care.

The rest of the staff, from the reception to the nurses, were always kind, caring, and welcoming.

It's wonderful to know that there are people and professionals like her who can help our dogs!

Professional clinic which thoroughly diagnosed my dog. After horrible experiences in the UK where my dog was misdiagnosed and prescribed wrong medication, Dr Bonaldi presented a clear treatment plan - bloods, mri and then appropriate medication. The vets speak perfect English so there’s no issues if you’re not speaking Italian. The mri and anaesthesia went well and I was able to be with my dog during initial sedation. The diagnosis itself was not something easy to process but I feel that my little dog is under great care and that he can live a happy life despite his neurological issues. Grazie mille!

Our Jack, a 5-year-old Weimaraner, underwent surgery three months ago at this veterinary clinic for Wobbler's Syndrome. We were fortunate to be referred to this highly specialized center. Everything went well. Jack is back to normal. We extend our heartfelt thanks to the entire staff, especially Dr. Lombardo and Dr. Baccolini, for their great professionalism, passion, and kindness.

Dr. Cozzi and her staff expertly and compassionately supported my poodle's geriatric journey. Thanks to them, his quality of life was excellent, and she candidly helped me make the difficult final decision. Time has passed, but my gratitude remains unchanged.
Very knowledgeable
Dr. Cozzi top
Good structure, I have done an examination on my dachshund and I am satisfied.
Professional and competent staff, a facility specializing in neurology where we have always found ourselves well.
A center of excellence, well-organized, and highly professional. A great love for animals.

I want to share this wonderful experience with you.
Today we took our little Minou for her post-op checkup. Three months ago, she underwent spinal surgery by Dr. Rocco Lombardo for a very serious spinal malformation.
The surgery was a complete success. Without it, our little girl would have been paralyzed shortly thereafter! What can I say...we're so thrilled by this extraordinary result! And a special shout-out to the wonderful Dr. Francesca Cozzi, who has been treating our neurological team for two years. We found unparalleled expertise, professionalism, and humanity in this clinic! From the front desk to the entire staff 🙏🙏🙏 thank you 🙏🙏🙏
They operated on my Snoopy for a hernia that would have paralyzed him. They were fantastic and above all very professional. Thank you.
Really excellent structure and staff!

Excellent care, neurologists and anesthesiologists.
MRI scan, a super positive experience
for our Frenchie.
Recommended
Very welcoming and professional staff
They saved our Camillo's life, I don't need to add anything else!
At the NVA clinic they are true professionals, the Italian excellence in their sector, they recommend Sergio Zingarelli

They saved my little Joy from a very high risk of paralysis.
I thank God that my fantastic vet immediately put me in touch with the wonderful Dr. Bonardi.
I thank Dr. Bonardi's professionalism and experience for realizing the seriousness of my little Bouldogue's situation.
I thank the anesthesiologists.
I thank the surgeon who operated on my little girl, thus giving her the opportunity to run, play, and do all the things every animal has the right to do.
I thank Dr. Ortu for supporting my little girl on her final journey after the operation and for joyfully telling us she hadn't expected such a quick recovery.
And thanks also go to the girls at the reception desk for knowing how to handle an owner like me. EVERYONE, from the first to the last, was very patient with me, even though I'm quite emotional; not everyone would have had the same humanity and empathy.
And I'm sorry, but anyone who says this is a clinic that only cares about money is sorely mistaken.
Precisely because of my emotional state, precisely because of my anxiety, I wanted to have an MRI on my other bulldog, just to be safe, and Dr. Bonardi advised against it, explaining that until the dog starts showing signs of pain, it's just an unnecessary expense.
It saved me €1,000.00...
There was also a chance that my Joy would have needed physical therapy after the surgery, but they told me it wasn't necessary because she's completely healed, and here too I had another huge saving...
How many clinics would have done all this?
THEY WERE SUPER HONEST!!!!!!
You saved my Joy, and I thank you infinitely from the bottom of my heart for the love and passion you put into saving our beloved animals, who are like family to each of us.
